Hospitality
THE SHOOLIN GROUP
Majestic Hospitality
The Shoolin Group began in 2018 with Shoolin Resorts in Manipal, a lavish 9-bedroom bungalow. Five years later, they expanded by acquiring Shoolin Palace, a prestigious resort in Mangalore, which today is a popular choice for a  convenient and exotic destination to celebrate all your life’s major events. In 2024, they secured Hotel Shoolin Grand, a prime property in downtown Mangalore. In 2025, they introduced Hotel Shoolin Comforts, a premium stay near the airport.

Enchanting Experiences
Enchanting Events Under The Stars
Shoolin Palace offers an unparalleled setting for events in Mangalore that demand nothing less than perfection. Whether you're planning an intimate gathering or a grand celebration, Shoolin Palace offers the ideal setting and backdrop for any occasion. From vibrant weddings to corporate retreats to cultural events, our dedicated team is always ready to serve you.
